description: Use with a session bearer to sign in to Squads (POST /api/social/login/wallet-session); returns {social, profile, badge}, where social is the cookie value every Squads tool takes.

address.description: Public 0x EVM address. Never a key or seed.

session.description: Wallet session bearer from memeswap_session_open. Used for this call only, never stored or echoed.

name: memeswap_social_login
